title: Fix oh_bootstrap logs fetch entity_type bug
description: Why: Logs fetch uses entity_type=context but logs are stored per-endeavor, causing empty results always. Done when: Logs are properly fetched by aggregating across endeavors or using correct API.

title: Add stderr logging for caught exceptions in oh_bootstrap
description: Why: Empty catch blocks swallow errors making debugging difficult. Done when: Caught exceptions log to stderr with console.error before continuing.

title: Extract Personal Workspace detection to shared helper
description: Why: 'Personal Workspace' string hardcoded in two places. Done when: Single isPersonalWorkspace() helper used in both locations.

title: Fix timezone bug in oh_get_logs: endDate uses UTC instead of including today's logs across all timezones
Add multi-context guidance tip to oh_bootstrap
description: Why: Users with multiple contexts don't know they can pass context_id. Done when: Thorough mode mentions context_id option when contextCount > 1.

title: Handle no-contexts edge case in oh_bootstrap
description: Why: If user has no contexts, guidance proceeds without clear indication of broken state. Done when: Bootstrap returns clear 'Getting Started' message for users with no OH setup.

title: Add Zod validation for oh_bootstrap API responses
description: Why: API responses cast to any without validation; schema changes will silently break. Done when: Context and dashboard responses validated with Zod schemas.
